claims.statement: Lived at the manor of Cloux near the royal château at Amboise. His presence is documented in October 1517 and at the will of April 1519.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Travel diary of Antonio de Beatis, 10 October 1517; will of 23 April 1519.
